outcome: Unplanned procedures (reaspiration, cervical laceration repair, uterine balloon tamponade)
cohort: 664 patients undergoing dilation and evacuation (D&E) for abortion between 18 and 22 weeks gestation
finding: While procedure time was found to be longer with adjunctive mifepristone compared to misoprostol, this difference was not clinically meaningful, and the frequency of acute complications was similar between groups.
